description: Prepare one reviewable patch to this project's Git checkout. The user reviews the exact diff in the chat and must explicitly approve before any files change.

files.path: Project-relative UTF-8 file path with forward slashes
files.digest: Full-file SHA-256 from fs.read, or null only to create a file in an existing directory

edits.old: Exact unique text to match, including newlines

limits: 1–16 files, 1–64 sequential edits per file, 256 KiB proposal and preview. An empty old match requires an empty or new file.
